newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end up after falling on Wednesday on rate woe.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end up after falling on Wednesday on rate woe.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures rebounded by the Thursday close after Wednesday's sell-off on a report that the Bank of Japan (BOJ) was considering the timing for a credit tightening.
"The report came at a time when bidders at the new 10-year JGB auction went all long. That caused the heavy sell-off yesterday," said a dealer at a city bank's securities unit.
"Today was a reverse of what happened on Wednesday," he said. The key June contract ended up 0.59 at 123.88.
A senior BOJ official later on Wednesday denied the report and said the BOJ had no plans to raise rates immediately.
